definition: Demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.
exampleSentence: The supervisor insisted that all team members submit their progress reports by noon.

definition: Induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument.
exampleSentence: She persuaded her colleagues to support the green energy initiative.

definition: Confess to be true or to be the case.
exampleSentence: The spokesperson reluctantly admitted that production deadlines had been missed.

definition: State that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of.
exampleSentence: The minister firmly denied having participated in the controversial financial scheme.

definition: Say or do something to remove the doubts and fears of someone.
exampleSentence: The airline captain reassured passengers that the turbulence was entirely standard.

definition: Give advice to someone on social or personal problems.
exampleSentence: The legal advisor counseled against accepting an out-of-court settlement.

definition: Persuade someone not to take a particular course of action.
exampleSentence: Friends attempted to dissuade him from investing all savings into cryptocurrency.

definition: Strongly encourage or urge someone to do something.
exampleSentence: The prime minister exhorted citizens to conserve electrical energy during peak hours.

definition: Make a formal request to an authority with respect to a cause.
exampleSentence: Neighborhood associations petitioned the borough council to establish a conservation zone.

definition: Express someone's disapproval of or disappointment in their actions.
exampleSentence: The dean reproached the department for failing to submit ethical clearance reports.
